about.title: Part founder, part product owner, part builder.
paragraphs: I’m a mathematician, serial entrepreneur and technology innovator. In the early 2000s, I helped bring premium-rate interactive television quiz shows to more than 200 channels in nearly 70 countries, establishing over 40 studios across Europe, the Middle East and Asia.

After a stroke in 2009, I left the media industry and turned to early-stage businesses and technology ventures. I launched **Indulj.Be** and **Mobile Weekend** in 2011, worked with startups including **Grofie** and **Leonar3Do**, then focused on big data, recommendation systems and machine learning. From 2016 to 2020, I led Ringier Axel Springer’s Abimato Laboratory and an MVP Factory operating across 21 European countries.

During the COVID-19 lockdowns, I founded **amanoba**, supporting the move to digital education across more than 700 institutions in three countries. Since 2022, my work has focused on locally deployed AI and business applications, with an emphasis on privacy, security and technological independence. I continue building products and supporting founders through Moldován Csaba Kft.

method.title: Eight D's, from idea to impact.
method.intro: Every engagement runs through one repeatable framework — so nothing falls through the cracks between strategy and shipping.

steps.name: Discover
steps.text: Understand the problem, users and market. Validate the real need before a line of code.

steps.name: Discuss
steps.text: Align stakeholders on goals, constraints and success metrics.

steps.name: Define
steps.text: Turn intent into a sharp scope, roadmap and prioritised backlog.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: Shape the experience — flows, interface and architecture.

steps.name: Develop
steps.text: Build in tight iterations with working software every step.

steps.name: Deliver
steps.text: Ship to production, instrument it, and get it into real hands.

steps.name: Data
steps.text: Measure behaviour and outcomes — let evidence steer decisions.

steps.name: Drive
steps.text: Iterate, grow and pivot. Keep momentum until it compounds.

studio.title: Moldován Csaba Kft
paragraphs: A Budapest-based product studio and venture vehicle. We partner with founders and teams to **design, build and ship software products** — and we invest our own time and craft into a growing portfolio of platforms.
Whether you need a fractional product leader to steady a roadmap, a hands-on builder to take a concept to launch, or a partner to help you pivot — the goal is the same: **make your product done.**
